info.description: Multiplayer paper-trading league. Decimals are strings; every response field is present (null when unused); errors are RFC 9457 problems with a stable `code`. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer stk_…` (bots, scripts) or the browser session cookie plus the X-XSRF-TOKEN header.
info.title: stocks API

tags.description: Place, preview, list, replace and cancel orders
